summary: Word Bank keeps a personal vocabulary list on the device. Users import words from a plain text file they choose, one word per line, skipping words already in the list, add a meaning to a word, and search words by text. Words persist on the device and are restored after restart.
targetUsers: Language learners building a personal vocabulary list
Anyone who keeps a plain text list of words to learn
goals: Keep a persistent on-device list of vocabulary words
Import words in bulk from a plain text file the user chooses
Attach a meaning to each word
Find words quickly by searching text
nonGoals: Sharing or syncing words across devices

features.name: Word list
features.userOutcome: The user sees all kept vocabulary words and their meanings, restored after restart.
features.behavior: Shows every stored word with its meaning, newest created first. Each row shows the word and its meaning when one has been added. When no words are stored, the list shows the text "No words yet. Add a word or import a file." Words are read from on-device storage when the app opens, so the list is restored after restart.
features.failureOutcome: Stored words cannot be read; the list stays empty and the app continues running.
acceptanceSignals: With no stored words, the list shows the text "No words yet. Add a word or import a file."
After words are stored and the app is restarted, the list shows the same words in newest-created-first order.
A stored word with a meaning shows both the word and the meaning in its row.

features.name: Import words
features.userOutcome: The user bulk-adds words from a plain text file, skipping words already in the list.
features.trigger: The user chooses Import and picks a plain text file in the Open panel.
features.behavior: Reads the chosen plain text file, one word per line. Each line is trimmed; blank lines are ignored. A word whose trimmed text matches a word already in the list, compared case-insensitively, is skipped. Every other word is stored with an empty meaning. After the import the list shows the newly added words newest created first.
features.failureOutcome: The chosen file cannot be read; no words are added and the list stays as it was.
acceptanceSignals: Importing a file containing "apple", "Banana", "apple", and a blank line into an empty list adds exactly two words, "apple" and "Banana".
Importing a file whose words are all already in the list adds no rows and the list is unchanged.
The import feature asks the user to choose a file in an Open panel.

features.name: Add meaning
features.userOutcome: The user attaches a meaning to a word.
features.trigger: The user chooses a word's meaning action in the list.
features.behavior: Opens a dialog with a text input for the meaning, prefilled with the word's current meaning. The meaning is trimmed; saving is disabled when the trimmed meaning is empty. On save the word's meaning is updated and the row shows the new meaning.
features.failureOutcome: The meaning cannot be stored; the dialog stays open with the entered meaning.
acceptanceSignals: With an empty or whitespace-only meaning, the save button is disabled and the validate function returns an error without calling the store.
After saving the meaning "a fortunate discovery" for "serendipity", the row for "serendipity" shows "a fortunate discovery".
After restart, the saved meaning is still shown for the word.

features.name: Search words
features.userOutcome: The user narrows the list to words matching typed text.
features.trigger: The user types in the search field.
features.behavior: Filters the list to words whose word text contains the typed text, compared case-insensitively. The search field starts empty, showing all words. Clearing the search field returns to showing all words.
features.failureOutcome: The search text cannot be applied; the list shows all words.
acceptanceSignals: Typing "ser" shows only words whose text contains "ser", compared case-insensitively.
Clearing the search field shows all stored words again.
With an empty search field, every stored word is shown.

dataObjects.name: Words
dataObjects.purpose: Vocabulary words kept on the device with their meanings.
dataObjects.retentionIntent: Kept on the device until the user removes the app's data.

dataObjects.name: Imported word file
dataObjects.purpose: A plain text file the user chooses to import words from, one word per line.
dataObjects.retentionIntent: Read once during import; the file stays where the user keeps it.

qualityRequirements: Words and meanings survive an app restart.
Import skips words already in the list, compared case-insensitively.
productConstraints: Words are imported only from a plain text file with one word per line.
The app does not edit or delete existing words.
